Your Spanish verbs note now has a flashcard page. Open the note and switch to **Page** to use it. I haven't opened it in the app, so I haven't seen it run.

- **Cards:** Each card shows the Spanish verb. Tap it to flip to the English. All 12 verbs are in.
- **Marking cards:** "I know it" marks a card as known. "Still learning" moves it back to the unknown group.
- **Order:** Cards you haven't learned come first, and known ones go to the end. A progress bar and a "left to learn" count sit above the card.
- **Memory:** I added a **Known** column to the note's table, and the page writes "Yes" there when you mark a card. The page reads the table each time it opens, so your progress stays between sessions. New verbs you add to the table show up as cards automatically.
- **Navigation:** There are Prev and Next buttons. "Reset all" clears every known mark after you confirm.
